story.title: Why we built Avino
story.lead: Finding a home in Uzbekistan is still harder than it should be.
story.p1: Listings are scattered across dozens of chats and boards, prices are opaque, and a chain of intermediaries often stands between the buyer and the owner. We set out to bring the market together in one place — clear, honest and convenient.
story.p2: Avino is a modern platform where anyone can find an apartment, house or commercial property, contact the other side directly, and decide based on complete information. We're building it for the whole country, in a language that works for everyone.

price.q: How much does it cost to post a listing?
price.a: Basic publication on Avino is free. The paid options are TOP and VIP promotion, which push a listing higher in search results and increase the number of views.

contact.q: How do I contact an owner or agent?
contact.a: The listing page shows the author's contacts — phone and chat. Avino Pro marks verified professionals with a special badge.

moderation.a: Yes. All listings go through moderation: we check the accuracy of the data, photos, and price to keep search results honest.

languages.q: What languages does the portal support?
languages.a: The Avino interface is available in three languages: Uzbek, Russian, and English. You can switch the language in the site header.

map.q: Can I search for properties on the map?
map.a: Yes, search results include a map mode — properties are shown as pins with prices, which makes it easy to choose by location.

favorites.q: How do I save a listing to favorites?
favorites.a: Tap the heart icon in the top right corner of a listing card. To save listings and come back to them, sign in to your account with a code from SMS.

savedSearch.a: It is your search parameters (district, price, number of rooms) saved in your account. Turn on notifications — and Avino will email you when new matching listings appear.

contactAuthor.q: How do I contact the listing author?
contactAuthor.a: On the listing page, click “Message” to open a chat with the author, or “Show phone”. You need to sign in to do this.

postListing.q: How do I post a listing?
postListing.a: Click “Post” in the header, sign in with a code and fill out the 6-step form: type, parameters, price, address on the map, photos and description. After submission the listing goes to moderation.

moderation.a: Usually a few hours. Once approved, the listing becomes active, appears in search and is automatically translated into Uzbek, Russian and English.

topVip.q: What is the difference between TOP and VIP?
topVip.a: TOP raises your listing above regular ones in search results. VIP adds a premium badge and gives maximum reach. Plans are available for 7, 14 and 30 days.

rejected.a: Most often because of incorrect photos, a duplicate, a wrong price or an incomplete description. Fix the issue mentioned in the notification and submit the listing again.

login.a: Enter your phone number — you will receive a confirmation code by SMS. Enter the code and you are in. No password needed.

language.q: How do I change the interface language?
language.a: Use the language switcher in the header (UZ / RU / EN) or change the language in the “Profile” section of your account.

safeDeal.a: These are Avino's recommendations on checking the property and documents, meeting in safe places and protecting yourself from fraud. Avino never asks for prepayment for a viewing.
